description: This file defines the `SubjectDeleted` event class, representing the event emitted after a Subject is deleted in the policy management system. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, accessors, and serialization logic.

classes.name: SubjectDeleted
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the deletion of a Subject in a policy, including factory methods for creation from parameters and JSON, and methods for serialization and equality.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create an instance of SubjectDeleted with parameters, supporting deprecation and preferred usage with typed PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of SubjectDeleted from a JSON string or object, deserializing the event.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the Policy Entry involved in the deletion.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path representing the path to the deleted subject.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the event payload into JSON using the provided builder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the event's fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality checks allowing subclass extension.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
